text: The cleanup removes OpenPGP-local Bob/message fixture copies and redirects setup plus both S/MIME message callers to ../smime/data. The sibling S/MIME manifest owns the data/** asset glob. This consolidates the refresh location; it does not prove old and new fixture bytes are identical or that isolated harness packaging succeeds. The original shortcut test checks the popup event, while accepted later recipient assertions are a separate phase. No fixture or UI test was executed.
title: OpenPGP security UI tests consume the owning S/MIME fixture directory
